title: Create the issue-triage fix/review loop
prompt: Make me a GeneratorAI workflow for bug issues: it takes an issue URL, triages it (summary, the files involved, a plan), then fixes and reviews in a loop until the reviewer approves, at most 5 rounds and about 10 dollars, and then opens a pull request, but only after I approve the result. Submit it for me to review.

shape: a triage agent stage with output.format json and a schema holding at least a summary and a plan
a loop stage with maxIterations <= 5 and a budget (maxTurns, and maxCostUsd or maxTokens)
fix and review agent stages whose parentKey is the loop key; review is read-only (permissionMode plan) with a JSON verdict
a complete exit rule reading the review verdict, and preferably an exhaust rule on no progress
a person approves before the pull request: approval on the last stage with postProcessing.autoCreatePR, or an approval wait gated by outcome == 'approved' before a PR stage

pass: validation passes within 3 validate calls (validate_workflow, generatorai workflow lint or scripts/validate.mjs)
plan_workflow (or generatorai workflow plan) is called and its result summarised to the user BEFORE the draft is created
the draft is created with create_workflow_draft or generatorai workflow import; the agent does not publish or run it

no forbidden fields: no __, repo_path_ or repo_branch_ variables, no old field names (copilotConfig, harnessConfig, condition, retryPolicy, approvalRequired, orchestratorConfig), no bypassPermissions, no literal secrets, no check stages or hooks the user did not ask for
the summary to the user names each stage, the permission modes, the loop limits and budget, and that the run opens a PR after approval
